newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta shares end lower with eyes on U.S data.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta shares end lower with eyes on U.S data.

text.p: Jakarta share prices ended lower on Wednesday as many operators continued to sell-off their stocks in late trade, brokers said.
The Jakarta Composite Index fell 2.97 points, or 0.54 percent, to 543.03 points after touching an intra-day low of 541.58 points late in the day.
Losers led gainers by 57 to 44, with 45 counters unchanged.
"Overall market sentiment was weak due to uncertainty in regional markets with many operators watching out for the U.S employment figures on Friday," one foreign broker said.
